nodes.label: D'Hondt Calculator Page
nodes.rationale: Main UI for the D'Hondt proportional representation system simulator.

nodes.rationale: Handles authentication for the D'Hondt calculator via the /api endpoint.

edges.rationale: Both files share the same authentication session key and target the same electoral management domain.
